text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, SQL, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m interested in your lead generation role because I understand you are looking specifically for software service leads from the Middle East, Canada, and the USA, and I’m comfortable working with structured lead lists, lead qualification, and clear segmentation by stage.

I want to be upfront that I do not offer SEO or digital marketing services. My focus is on clean, organized, usable data and helping you identify leads that match your criteria. If you already have leads in hand and want help organizing, qualifying, or reviewing them before sharing one by one, I can support that process carefully and consistently.

One relevant project I completed was a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel, replacing 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work consolidated 14 reports into 1 and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. This project reflects the way I work: focused on accuracy, clarity, and making information easier to act on.

For your lead work, I can help with data cleaning, lead tracking, spreadsheet organization, and qualification support so you can review leads quickly and make decisions based on the stage of each lead: cold, hot, or qualified. I understand that your definition of a qualified lead can be discussed in a web meeting, and I’m open to that.

If you already have software development leads from India-based agency buyers in your target regions, I’d be glad to discuss how I can help manage and present them in a clear format. I work carefully, communicate clearly, and can adapt to your lead-sharing process one lead at a time.

If this sounds aligned, I’d be happy to connect and discuss your requirements further.
